caption:
Yes, there's chlorine in your tap water 💧 On purpose.
Water companies in England and Wales must keep a tiny amount in it so it stays hygienic all the way to your tap. Typical levels are around 0.5 mg/l or less, about a tenth of the WHO's 5 mg/l guideline.
Don't like the taste? Chill a jug in the fridge and throw it out after 24 hours.

Can you taste it where you live? Comment your town 👇
Source: Drinking Water Inspectorate
